_comment: Two-target crossing scenario for the tracker stress test (Approach 1, range-axis crossing with opposite-sign Doppler). Two targets approach each other along the range axis and meet at range = 4 m around frame ~20 (at 20 Hz frame rate). Their velocities have equal magnitude but opposite sign, so they remain Doppler-separable throughout — the crossing is in range only, not in (range, velocity). Used to test the tracker's data-association logic at the moment of closest approach. Amplitudes are well above the CFAR detection threshold, so detection itself is not the failure mode; the variable of interest is whether the tracker maintains stable track IDs through the crossing.
